blocks.html: From L-R: PhilHealth Field Operations Division Chief Mr. Arturo C. Ardiente, PhilHealth Area Vice President Gregorio L. Rulloda, RLC Executive Vice President Faraday D. Go and RLC Commercial Centers Division (CCD) Senior Vice President and General Manager Arlene G. Magtibay

In its aim to provide health benefits to more Filipinos, Philippine Health Insurance Corporation (PhilHealth) is opening more satellite offices in Robinsons Malls. The first on the list is slated to open in Robinsons Galleria South in San Pedro Laguna by the second quarter of the year. This was recently formalized in a contract signing recently held in Xin Tian Di, Crowne Plaza Manila Galleria.
Present during the signing are (from L-R): PhilHealth Field Operations Division Chief Mr. Arturo C. Ardiente, PhilHealth Area Vice President Gregorio L. Rulloda, RLC Executive Vice President Faraday D. Go and RLC Commercial Centers Division (CCD) Senior Vice President and General Manager Arlene G. Magtibay.
In 2011, Robinsons Land Corporation, (RLC) signed a Memorandum of Agreement with the Philippine Health Insurance for the hosting of “Philhealth Express” satellite offices. Through this undertaking, Philhealth members are now able to enroll and register members, update its MDR records (MDR). PhilHealth Express also offers public assistance and inquiry desk that accepts manually transmitted remittance reports, receive off -application from healthcare providers and professionals and receiving of manually transmitted benefit claims.
Currently, there are 30 PhilHealth Express Offices in Robinsons Malls Lingkod Pinoy Centers open Monday to Friday from 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM. By the end of the year, another Satellite Offices will open in Robinsons Place Pavia.

ROBINSONS MALLS LINGKOD PINOY CENTERS is an innovative public service program that started in 2011. These “Lingkod Pinoy Centers” aim to bring under one roof the satellite offices of key government agencies that deal heavily with the public including DFA, NBI, SSS, Pag-IBIG Fund, LTO, PRC, Bureau of Immigration, POEA, OWWA, PHLPost, TESDA, TIEZA, SEC, LRA and the Philippine Health Insurance Corporation or otherwise known as “PhilHealth”.
